Note: This role is exclusively available to U.S. citizens who can obtain and maintain a U.S. government-issued Top
Secret security clearance with full-scope polygraph. There are no exceptions.

Who We Are:

Our mission at Hazel is simple and powerful. We use AI to help U.S. government purchasing teams buy at the speed of need
with unparalleled efficiency and cost-effectiveness. It is a $2.7T problem every single year, and Hazel is at the
forefront with Federal and State, Local, and EDucation (SLED) agencies.  

Hazel has identified a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to solve this by deploying cutting-edge AI to the public sector
and unlocking the full potential of our nation. We empower our partners to move with expediency against the most
pressing challenges of this century. Hazel builds AI for the public interest.

What We Are Building:

Hazel is transforming government procurement: how government agencies purchase goods and services from commercial
vendors. You’ll work directly with our federal partners in deploying our AI-forward bid evaluations solution, helping
them assess vendors more accurately, reliably, and quickly. With the federal government under increasing pressure to
accelerate acquisitions, our tools give them a real edge.

Our full COTS platform supports the entire procurement lifecycle from need identification through award management, and
our other partners include state & local governments, schools, and special authorities.

About the Role:

As a Hazel full stack engineer, you will be at the helm of architecting and building Hazel’s platform. You will work
closely with Hazel’s customers to identify pain points to prioritize the most impactful features.  You will build new
features every week and be faced with many challenging technical problems. Most importantly, you join the tip of the
spear in delivering effective and secure AI for the public sector.

This specific role is for deploying and scaling Hazel's cutting-edge AI for our largest contract with one of the most
important U.S. government agencies. You will bring it into production by owning the customization, security
accreditation, and deployment of Hazel in a unique operational environment.

  - Define, iterate, and execute on projects contributing to Hazel’s federal and commercial product roadmap

    structures in classified environments 
  - Collaborate with colleagues, customers, and partners to understand key tactical and strategic priorities and deliver

  - Take ownership of projects, ensuring they meet rigorous standards of quality, performance, and security

  - Proven experience as a full stack engineer or similar role 
  - Proven experience with the technologies in our Tech Stack, which includes:
      - Designing and implementing AWS cloud infrastructure 
      - Python 
      - Typescript 
      - React/Next.js  
      - PostgreSQL  
      - CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub, CodePipeline) 
      - IaC (CDK/Terraform) 
      - Familiarity with Auth N/Auth Z/SAML/SSO/IdP 
      - Docker
  - Adeptness with using AI Coding Tools (e.g. Cursor/Claude Code)

  - Excitement about bringing innovation to the public sector 
  - Continuous drive towards learning and personal development  
  - TS/SCI with FSP

You’ll work side-by-side with inquisitive and driven founders as well as a world-class and dynamic founding engineering

Hazel is a mission-driven organization founded by engineers and built around delivering world-class innovation to our

You care about mission. Hazel partners with agencies supporting everything from public school teachers in the classroom

You want a startup that is structured without being rigid, quality-obsessed without being slow, and product-led without

You solve problems. There’s no more time to opine on strategy and policy when our nation faces existential challenges,

You are always learning. Nobody has all the answers, and the world is ever-evolving, so we must be adaptive. We bring

You believe in team. Our team grows together, supports one another, and elevates our shared successes. We are more

articles.title: Maxproof
articles.originalTitle: Maxproof
articles.excerpt: We present MaxProof, a population-level test-time scaling framework for competition-level mathematical proof in the MiniMax-M3 series. M3 first trains three proof-oriented capabilities -- proof generation, proof verification, and critique-conditioned proof repair -- using a defense-in-depth generative verifier engineered for low false-positive rate. These capabilities are merged into a single released M3 model. At test time, MaxProof treats the model as a generator, verifier, refiner, and ranker, searches over a population of candidate proofs, and returns one final proof through tournament selection. With MaxProof test-time scaling, the M3 model reaches 35/42 on IMO 2025 and 36/42 on USAMO 2026, exceeding the human gold-medal threshold on both.

articles.excerpt: Jesteś nie tylko członkiem OFE, jesteś inwestorem – mówi do swoich klientów PTE PZU, zarządzające funduszem PZU Złota Jesień. Zaprasza ich do udziału w ankietach, w których mogą wskazać, jak zagłosowaliby jako akcjonariusze na walnych zgromadzeniach wybranych spółek. articles.title: Polska ma zapłacić Pfizerowi miliardy. Teraz Belgia żąda jeszcze 170 mln zł
articles.originalTitle: Polska ma zapłacić Pfizerowi miliardy. Teraz Belgia żąda jeszcze 170 mln zł
articles.excerpt: Najpierw 5,6 mld zł dla Pfizera za niewykorzystane i nieodebrane szczepionki przeciw COVID-19. Teraz, jak wynika z informacji Rynku Zdrowia, do Polski trafiło kolejne wezwanie do zapłaty: tym razem od Belgii, na kwotę blisko 170 mln zł. Chodzi o 3 proc. podatku od przegranej sprawy z amerykańskim koncernem. To opłata za to, że sprawa toczyła się przed belgijskim sądem. Polska kwestionuje żądanie. Już wysłała notę dyplomatyczną.

articles.title: Tyle ryb można zjeść bez obaw o rtęć. Oto konkretne wyliczenia
articles.originalTitle: Tyle ryb można zjeść bez obaw o rtęć. Oto konkretne wyliczenia
articles.excerpt: Ryby są doskonałym źródłem białka, witamin z grupy B i zdrowych tłuszczów. Zgodnie z Talerzem Zdrowego Żywienia tygodniowo powinniśmy jeść 1-2 porcje ryb tygodniowo, co przekłada się na ok. 150-300 g. Jak się okazuje, istnieją też górne limity, których nie powinno się przekraczać.

articles.title: Amerykanie redukują siły w Europie. Myśliwce i okręty USA opuszczą Stary Kontynent
articles.originalTitle: Amerykanie redukują siły w Europie. Myśliwce i okręty USA opuszczą Stary Kontynent
articles.excerpt: Stany Zjednoczone planują znacząco zredukować liczbę swoich myśliwców, okrętów i samolotów dostępnych dla operacji NATO w Europie - poinformował w piątek dziennik "New York Times", powołując się na dwóch wysokich rangą europejskich urzędników. Decyzja ta, przekazana sojusznikom na początku czerwca, może poważnie wpłynąć na zdolności obronne Sojuszu wobec potencjalnych zagrożeń ze strony Rosji. Redukcje mają nastąpić szybciej, niż spodziewali się europejscy partnerzy Waszyngtonu.
